label: NetApp AFF A250 entry all-flash array
description: 2U entry-level AFF all-flash system with two active-active controllers. Onboard I/O is 4 x 25GbE SFP28 (2 per controller, 10GbE autoranging) plus 2 x 1GbE RJ45 management ports (e0M, one per controller); PCIe slots take it to 20 x 25GbE or 16 x 32G FC for iSCSI, NVMe/TCP, NVMe/FC and NFS/SMB.
notes: NetApp lists onboard I/O as 4 x 25GbE and 2 x 1GbE management ports per system (per-system totals: 20 x 25GbE / 16 x 32G FC / 4 x 100GbE / 8 x 12Gb SAS once the 4 PCIe slots are populated). Storage-side SAS ports and the cluster-interconnect ports are internal to the HA pair and not modelled.
